eyebrow: DESS · A tech solution you can trust
lead: Professional technology solutions for homes, businesses and institutions across Nigeria, from system design to installation, maintenance and support.
about: DESS is the short name of Dabo Energy & Security Solutions, a technology and systems solutions company providing energy, security, connectivity, maintenance and technical consultation services.

why.title: Technical approach
why.text: We design systems around your requirements, not around the equipment on the shelf.

why.title: Professional installation
why.text: Neat installation, correct configuration and a clean finish.

why.title: Equipment selection
why.text: We help you specify dependable equipment suited to the project.

why.title: Support beyond installation
why.text: Maintenance, troubleshooting and upgrades for systems we install.

why.title: Experience
why.text: Over seven years in the industry, with 150+ projects completed.

why.title: Customer-focused service
why.text: Clear communication from first enquiry to handover.

cta_text: Tell us about your premises and requirements. We will help you identify the right solution.

faq.a: Yes. DESS designs and installs solar and backup power systems, including panels, inverters and battery storage, configured to your requirements.

faq.q: Do you install CCTV systems for businesses?
faq.a: Yes. We design and install CCTV systems for offices, shops, hotels, schools, hospitals, factories and estates, including DVR/NVR recording and remote viewing setup.
Yes. We inspect, troubleshoot, repair where applicable and upgrade existing CCTV systems.

faq.q: Can DESS handle large commercial projects?
faq.a: DESS is equipped and positioned to take on commercial and institutional projects, from planning and system design to installation, configuration and support. Share your requirements and we will discuss the scope with you.
Yes. Our Mararaba base serves Nasarawa, Abuja and surrounding areas.

faq.q: Do you serve outside Kano and Abuja?
faq.a: Yes. DESS can take on projects nationwide and outside Nigeria depending on requirements. Pricing may vary with location, logistics and scope.

Yes. We handle Starlink equipment supply, installation, activation assistance, Wi-Fi and network configuration, relocation and mounting, troubleshooting and maintenance, and subscription enquiries. Contact us for current plan details and the purchase or renewal process.

faq.q: Do you provide maintenance after installation?
faq.a: Yes. Maintenance and technical support are a core DESS service for solar, CCTV, connectivity and other installed systems.
Yes. We can advise on the right solution before you buy equipment or begin installation.
Phone consultations are free. Site consultations are paid, and the price depends on the location.

faq.q: Do you work with hotels, schools and hospitals?
faq.a: We are equipped to serve these sectors. Requirements differ between them, so we begin by understanding your premises and needs.
